verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is an identity/access management platform, not an agentic AI tool that consumes MCP servers as a client to gain tool capabilities; the evidence pack shows only identity/access features (SSO, provisioning, Conditional Access, Graph API) and a docs-related MCP server, which is unrelated to Entra plugging into MCP servers itself. This axis is a category error for this product type.
